text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
次の対戦相手のアレキサンドラについて、
もう少し調べておきました。
text.official_en:
I have looked into our next opponent in the games—
one Alexandra.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼女は豊穣の女神ジュラの神殿に仕える騎士で、
かなりの名門の生まれだそうです。
text.official_en:
She is a knight at the temple of Jurah, the goddess of
abundance and cultivation, and is of high birth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ただ、両親とはすでに死別しており、現在は
伯父に当たる人物の庇護下にあるようです。
text.official_en:
But her parents are dead, and it seems an uncle
serves as her guardian.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その伯父というのが、どうやら神殿の中でも
それなりの地位にある人物のようでして。
text.official_en:
However that uncle is no nameless peasant. Indeed,
he holds a high rank within the temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
もしかすると、大剣闘祭の運営に対して、
何らかの働きかけをしているのかもしれません。
text.official_en:
I believe he may be exerting his influence over how
the games themselves are being run.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……都会の女たちってさ、
なんかみんな華やかでキレイだよね。
text.official_en:
Everywhere I look in this city, I see women who are
elegant. Refined.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アレキサンドラって子の話を聞いたら、
なんかだんだん気になってきちゃってさ……
text.official_en:
For example, the more I hear about this Alexandra,
the more curious I get.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それに、この間ダーリンに口づけしてた
あの得体のしれない美人のこともあるし。
text.official_en:
Come to think of it, there was that pretty lady who
you kissed the other day, Sweetie.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ダーリンはさ、やっぱり、
頭がよくてキレイな女が好きだよね？
text.official_en:
You must like those kinds of women, then, right?
The refined ones.

text.jp: <NCA>美しさは重要だ
text.official_en: <NCA>Extol the virtue of beauty.

text.jp: <NCB>特に気にしていない
text.official_en: <NCB>Disagree.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>まあ、確かにこのままじゃダーリンと
釣り合い悪いしって所はあるんだけどさ……
text.official_en: <ACA>Hm. I wonder if we're really a match.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>ほんと？　
気を遣ってもらえるのはありがたいけど。
text.official_en: <ACB>Really? Thanks for saying so.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACB>だけど、あたいにだって
女として意地みたいなものがあるんだよ。
text.official_en: <ACB>But don't count me out!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あー、もう。
あたい、どうすりゃいんだろう……
text.official_en: So...how do I decide what to do next?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
エスメラルダはああ言ってたけど、別に
そんなにムキになる必要なんてないのにね。
text.official_en:
Esmeralda has herself tied up in knots, and there's
no need for any of that!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
人間、何でもかんでも
他人と比べ始めるときりがないんだから。
text.official_en:
Once you start measuring yourself against the people
around you, there's no end to it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それに、あの子だって
見目はいい方だと思ってるんだけど。
text.official_en:
I don't know why she worries. She's a
good-looking girl!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
田舎育ちってことで、都会の女に対して
卑屈になってる部分があるんだろうかね。
text.official_en:
If you ask me, I think it's just because it's her first
time in the big city. It's throwing her off.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ……あの子くらいの年齢のときは、
そんなものかもしれないね。
text.official_en: It's tough for girls that age.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あら、あなたは確か……
次の予選試合で私と当たる方ですね。
text.official_en:
Oh my, aren't you... Yes, you're one of those whom
I'll be up against in the next qualifier.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
お会いできて光栄です。私も、
失礼のないよう、全力でいかせてもらいます。
text.official_en:
What an honor to meet you. I will fight you with all
my might. It's a matter of respect.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、勘違いされている方が多いのですが、
大剣闘祭というものは、本来は――
text.official_en:
Many have lost sight of the original purpose of
these Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ただ戦って勝敗を決すればいい
というようなものでは、決してないのです。
text.official_en: It wasn't purely meant to be a brutal spectacle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
長い眠りにつかれた神威大帝に
奉納するための神聖な戦いなのですから……
text.official_en:
The games are sacred—a series of battles dedicated
to the Divine Emperor in his long slumber.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp: ……君か。
text.official_en: Ah, it's you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私の言ったことを、
常に忘れぬようにしておくことだ。
text.official_en: Never forget what I told you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あ、あの……
もうすぐ次の試合ですよね……！
text.official_en: Your next match is soon...isn't it?

text.jp:
次も、頑張ってくださいね。
はい、これ……
text.official_en: I know you'll do your best, but please...take this!

text.jp:
あなたのこと、これからも応援してます。
頑張ってください……！
text.official_en:
You should know...my support for you will
never falter.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ああ……アレキサンドラちゃん、
可愛いなあ……
text.official_en: Alexandra, you're just divine!

text.jp:
次の試合では、アレキサンドラちゃんの
戦っている姿が見られるといいのだけど……
text.official_en:
Like an angel flitting down from the heavens on
your pegasus...
text.real_en: I hope I get to see Alexandra-chan fight in the next match...

text.jp:
おじさんが応援してるからね、
アレキサンドラちゃん。
text.official_en:
I can't wait to actually see you fight in the
next match!
text.real_en: This old man's cheering you on, Alexandra-chan.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
アレキサンドラさま、かっこいいなあ。
わたしも、あんな騎士になりたいなあ。
text.official_en:
Alexandra, one day I'll be a dashing knight, just
like you!
text.real_en: Alexandra-sama is so cool. I want to become a knight like her someday.

text.jp:
いつも愛馬と息がぴったりだから……
まずはペガサスと仲良くならないと！
text.official_en:
There's a special relationship between a pegasus
and its rider. I need to make friends with one!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
アレキサンドラって女、可愛い顔をして、
中身の方はどうなんだろうね。
text.official_en:
That Alexandra may act cute, but I have
my suspicions.

text.jp:
男どもは夢中になってるけど、
あの女の笑顔に騙されてるだけなんだよ。
text.official_en:
All these fools fall for her smile, but I know the
truth—it's all an act!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
次の対戦相手のアレキサンドラには
せいぜい気をつけるんだな。
text.official_en:
Be on guard. Your next match is against Alexandra,
after all.

text.jp:
あの女と対戦するはずだったのに、
試合の直前にならず者に襲われて、
text.official_en:
Rumor has it that something bad happened to the
last fighter unlucky enough to be paired with her.

text.jp:
こっぴどく痛めつけられて、試合に
出られなくなった奴もいるらしいぜ。
text.official_en:
Someone dragged him into an alley and beat the
stuffing out of him. He had to drop out of the games!

text.jp:
あんたも、夜道を歩くときは
気をつけたほうがいいかもしれないな。
text.official_en:
Don't walk around the city at night unless you're
looking for trouble, is my advice.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
アレキサンドラは、噂じゃ
背後に大物がついているらしいよ。
text.official_en:
Rumor has it that there's someone powerful behind
Alexandra's entry into the games.

text.jp:
そいつに何か魂胆があって、
アレキサンドラを優勝させようとしてるのさ。
text.official_en:
And he's going to do whatever it takes to make
sure she wins!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
なんか、貧民街のあたりに
目つきの悪い連中が溜まってるよ。
text.official_en:
I've seen a particularly nasty-looking gang hanging
around lowtown lately.
text.real_en:
I've seen a particularly nasty-looking gang hanging
around the slums lately.

text.jp:
あのへんに用事があるなら
あんたも気をつけておいた方がいい。
text.official_en: If you have business there, watch your back.
